name: grafta-video
description: The home page's demo video, as a Remotion composition.

scripts.studio: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts Demo out/demo.mp4 --crf 26 --port 3191 && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/demo.mp4 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -b:v 0 -crf 38 -row-mt 1 -an out/demo.webm
